summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing PDMR and closely-associated-person dealings under EU MAR Article 19, the non-US equivalent of Section 16 ownership-transaction reporting. The filings record tenders into the voluntary offer by Cadeler plc to all holders of Cadeler A/S shares, exchanging each DKK 1 Cadeler A/S share for one USD 1 Cadeler plc share, with ADSs exchanged on a four-for-one basis. CEO Mikkel Gleerup tendered 308,497 shares plus 4,000 ADSs (16,000 shares) on 2 November 2026 outside a trading venue. No board recommendation or advisor is stated. Watch acceptance levels and regulatory clearances.
